The best performers (bond_inflation_rotation_v1: PF=1.99, WR=45.5%; bond_credit_spread_term_v1: PF=1.51) have only n=9-11 trades - far below the 100-trade minimum for reliable inference. All results are further compromised by the simplified SMA-crossover signal translation, which does not faithfully represent the spec.entry logic described in each strategy. The cross-test independence is encouraging but insufficient given the tiny sample sizes. Retry conditions: (1) deploy faithful-signal translator (v3), (2) extend backtest window to generate ≥100 trades per candidate, (3) re-run with proper signal implementation before any GO verdict can be issued.
